name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_release
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::Release decrements the COM sink refcount and destroys/frees the object at zero.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x441620 validates the stdcall self-pointer contract, InterlockedDecrement(&self->m_refCountAndLock.refCount), nonzero return without destruction, zero-count call to WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::Destructor, operator delete, and returning the new refcount.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_lifetime_smoke verifies nonzero Release returns 1 while leaving the object/live count intact, and zero-count Release returns 0 after decrementing the live count through the destructor/free path.
